check_schema.strength: string: obligation strength for this predicate, not all linked source clauses
check_schema.evidence_needed: string: sufficient evidence and dependency boundary

check.applies_when: the independently associated originating email supplies media-type parameters
check.assertion: An embedded stream originating from an email with media-type parameters must contain Mail_MediaTypeParameters.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: original parameters and the corresponding stored PDF string are independently available
check.assertion: Stored Mail_MediaTypeParameters must preserve the parameters of the independently associated originating email.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: intermediate DPart email nodes and email-owned Content Sets
check.assertion: Intermediate email DPart nodes must associate each email with all and only its independently identified Content Sets.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite. Independent logical-content ownership must be established separately from the DPart identifier being tested.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.assertion: AttachmentRendering Mail_Subtype must identify the original attachment media type including parameters.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.assertion: NumberMessages must equal the successfully rendered emails attributable to that particular source-asset occurrence.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable. Independently owned rendered content and complete validated collection-child evidence may support the comparison.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: profiles s, si, m or mi
check.assertion: Email XMP record count must be exactly one for s/si and at least two for m/mi.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: an independently associated original supplies a nonempty applicable Core Field or has one or more attachments
check.assertion: Email XMP must include each applicable nonempty original Core Field and the attachment count when the original has attachments.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: a source-derived email metadata value is supplied and its independent original evidence can be assessed
check.assertion: Supplied source-derived email metadata must preserve the full original value as equivalently as representation and encoding permit.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.assertion: A supplied attachment XMP CheckSum must equal the MD5 digest of its independently associated native bytes stored in the EA-PDF.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: an attachment description can be associated with its original filename evidence
check.assertion: Attachment XMP Filename must preserve the exact original case-sensitive filename when supplied; otherwise a suitable generated filename is permitted.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.assertion: A supplied attachment Message-ID must identify its containing original email.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable. Corresponding email XMP may establish internal identity consistency; GUID ownership takes priority.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: nonzero retained native attachment and independently associated original bytes
check.assertion: Nonzero native attachment payloads should preserve the full decoded original attachment bytes.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.applies_when: qualifying native attachment annotations in an applicable owning BodyRendering Content Set
check.assertion: At least one qualifying FileAttachment annotation for each attachment/body-set pair must be visible and positioned entirely within its page CropBox.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite.

source_order.basis: Earliest applicable linked source page; ties by section, table, source requirement and stable predicate order.

check.assertion: Writers should supply the uncompressed payload byte size in embedded-file Params Size.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite.

check.assertion: Writers should supply the MD5 digest in embedded-file Params CheckSum.
check.evidence_needed: PDF objects, decoded embedded bytes and document XMP; successful veraPDF validation is the prerequisite.

check.assertion: Document-level attachment metadata should describe all original email attachments, including those removed for policy reasons.
check.evidence_needed: Independently associated readable original email or attachment and the generated PDF/XMP. A deliberately omitted isolated original is N/A; supplied but unreadable or ambiguous originals leave applicable comparisons unavailable.
